title: Shipped console moves to newsroom.shipped.anth.us: console edge stack, consoleOrigin, redirects, CLI and email origins, cut-over order
description:
Repo: **Shipped-web** (infra, config) plus two small Papyrus changes. Ryan 2026-10-31 (decided): Shipped's CMS console moves to its own host, `newsroom.shipped.anth.us`, like Anth.us (`newsroom.anth.us`); `shipped.anth.us/newsroom` becomes public. Today: `infra/edge/shipped.yaml` (stack `papyrus-edge-shipped`) ~161 sends `/newsroom*`, `/_next/*`, `/api/*` to the Amplify app `main.<CmsAppId>.amplifyapp.com`; `publication/brand.ts` `newsroomBasePath "/newsroom"`, `rootRoute` redirect `/` -> `/newsroom`; `infra/site.json` `cms.siteOrigin https://shipped.anth.us`, `cliRemoteLogin: true`, `PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS` (localhost:3001, shipped.anth.us, the amplifyapp.com host). OAuth, CLI login and reader sign-in are not path-bound (verified), so only origins and routes change.

## Steps (each a verifiable PR; pipelines do every AWS write, nobody by hand)
1. **Console edge stack** (Shipped-web `infra/edge/shipped-console.yaml`, new): our own ACM + CloudFront, copied from Papyrus `infra/edge/anth-us.yaml` (Anth.us's console distribution) per `infra/edge/README.md`. One distribution, alias `newsroom.shipped.anth.us`, origin the Amplify default domain, CachingDisabled + all-viewer origin request policy, the `x-forwarded-host` viewer-request function (copy `CmsViewerRequestFunction` from `shipped.yaml`), all methods, no S3 origin, no `CustomErrorResponses`. ACM certificate in us-east-1, DNS validation and the A/AAAA alias in the NEW `anth.us` zone in papyrus-production (memory: DNS zones). **No Amplify `create-domain-association`** (throttled in papyrus-production). Parameters only; no ids, ARNs or hostnames hard-coded beyond the alias.
2. **Papyrus: `consoleOrigin`.** `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/site-config.ts` + `amplify-app-shell.ts`: optional `cms.consoleOrigin`, default `siteOrigin`. It feeds: Cognito callback/logout URLs (`amplify/auth/redirect-urls.ts` `expandNewsroomRedirectUrls` gets both origins), `PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN` for the remote-login broker (`amplify/cli-login/remote-login.ts` `planCliRemoteLogin`; the approve/callback pages and `BROKER_TARGETS` move to the console host), the CLI discovery document (`lib/cli-login-discovery.ts` / `app/.well-known/papyrus-cli.json/route.ts`: `broker_endpoint`, `remote_callback_uri` use the console origin; the discovery file itself is fetched by the CLI from the site origin given on the command line, so document that `papyrus login --site https://newsroom.shipped.anth.us` is the new address and that the public host returns the same document), and email deep links: grep `newsroomBasePath` and `siteOrigin` in `amplify/plugins/newsletter/` (alert approval mails, `approval: "admin"`), `amplify/functions/*` notification mails and `lib/*mail*`; every console link uses `consoleOrigin`. Gherkin in Papyrus: `features_backend/console-origin.feature`.
3. **Shipped-web config.** `infra/site.json`: `cms.consoleOrigin: "https://newsroom.shipped.anth.us"`, `PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS` gains the new host (keep the old ones until step 6). `publication/brand.ts`: `newsroomBasePath` stays `/newsroom` and `rootRoute` keeps redirecting `/` -> `/newsroom` ON THE CONSOLE HOST; confirm against Anth.us-web `publication/brand.ts` and match it exactly. Bump to the Papyrus release from step 2 (four pins match).
4. **Verify the console on the new host** before touching the public edge: sign in at https://newsroom.shipped.anth.us/newsroom, `papyrus login --remote` against it (approve page on the new host), a newsletter approval mail links to the new host. Record on this task.
5. **Public edge** (`infra/edge/shipped.yaml`, second PR): remove the `/newsroom*` CacheBehavior so `/newsroom/` serves from S3; keep `/_next/*` and `/api/*` (public islands and `/api/reader/*` need them) and the `/cli/*` routes from #895 move to the console distribution (remove from the public one once step 4 passed). **301s, carefully:** the shared `RedirectAndIndexFunction` reads redirects from the KVS; the public `/newsroom/` and `/newsroom/<public section>/` must NOT redirect, so add one 301 rule per console segment: `/newsroom/<seg>*` -> `https://newsroom.shipped.anth.us/newsroom/<seg>...` for every directory under Papyrus `app/newsroom/` (read it; today at least `articles`, `references`, `messages`, `forum`, `insights`, `settings`, `administration`, `sign-in`, `search`) plus `/_next/*`? no: `/_next/*` stays. Also `/newsroom/sign-in` and the OAuth callback paths. Put the list in `infra/edge/README.md` and a test that parses the template/KVS seed against `app/newsroom/*` so a new console route cannot be shadowed silently.
6. **Clean-up PR:** drop the old `shipped.anth.us` entries from `PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS` and the public distribution's `/cli/*` behaviours; update `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `infra/README.md` ("console at newsroom.shipped.anth.us").

Cut-over order never leaves the console unreachable: the new host is live and verified (steps 1-4) while `/newsroom*` still works on the public host; step 5 switches the public host over with redirects; step 6 removes leftovers.

## Gherkin
Shipped-web: `tests/test_edge_rules.py` (parse templates): "The public /newsroom/ page is served from S3 and not redirected"; "An old console URL redirects once to the console host"; "/api/reader/* and /_next/* stay on the public host"; "/cli/* is served on the console host". Papyrus `features_backend/console-origin.feature`: "Callback URLs include both origins"; "The broker's PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN is the console origin"; "Console emails link to the console origin".

## Acceptance
Both hosts verified in a browser and with `papyrus login --remote`; redirect tests green; no ids in templates; every AWS change made by the Shipped-web / Papyrus pipelines. Not blocked on a decision. Depends on the Papyrus `consoleOrigin` release (step 2) before step 3.
